title: Item 2: Emergency Button Always Visible on Mobile

inputs.description: Fix emergency FAB being hidden when panel is expanded on mobile. In src/App.css around line 2448, the class .emergency-fab.fab-panel-expanded sets opacity:0 and pointer-events:none. Change this so the emergency button remains visible and tappable at all times regardless of panel state. Ensure it has proper z-index to float above the panel. Keep the button positioned so it doesn't overlap with critical panel controls. Test that it works with both collapsed and expanded panel states.
